1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GlobalCutTreeKites

3 
4 /-! A simple finite chain of actual tree edges. The first and last
5 edges are the kites to be separated; all intervening junctions use
6 the fixed global chart collection. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set Real
11 
12 /-- A simple chain with two end edges and `n` intermediate edges. -/
13 structure CutTreeChain {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
14     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (n : ℕ) where
15   vertex : Fin (n + 3) → T.vertices
16   simple : Function.Injective vertex
17   edge : ∀ i : Fin (n + 2), T.graph.Adj (vertex i.castSucc) (vertex i.succ)
18 
19 namespace CutTreeChain
20 
21 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} {n : ℕ}
22     (chain : CutTreeChain T n)
23 
24 def dart (i : Fin (n + 2)) : T.graph.Dart :=
25   ⟨(chain.vertex i.castSucc, chain.vertex i.succ), chain.edge i⟩
26 
27 theorem dart_injective : Function.Injective chain.dart := by
28   intro i j same
29   have first : chain.vertex i.castSucc = chain.vertex j.castSucc :=
30     congrArg (fun d : T.graph.Dart => d.fst) same
31   exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin (n + 3) => k.val) (chain.simple first))
32 
33 theorem dart_ne_reverse (i j : Fin (n + 2)) : (chain.dart i).symm ≠ chain.dart j := by
34   intro same
35   have first : chain.vertex i.succ = chain.vertex j.castSucc :=
36     congrArg (fun d : T.graph.Dart => d.fst) same
37   have second : chain.vertex i.castSucc = chain.vertex j.succ :=
38     congrArg (fun d : T.graph.Dart => d.snd) same
39   have h₁ := congrArg Fin.val (chain.simple first)
40   have h₂ := congrArg Fin.val (chain.simple second)
41   simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at h₁ h₂
42   omega
43 
44 theorem internal_neighbors_different (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
45     chain.vertex i.castSucc.castSucc ≠ chain.vertex i.succ.succ := by
46   intro same
47   have indices := congrArg Fin.val (chain.simple same)
48   simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at indices
49   omega
50 
51 /-- Each internal fan is selected from the one fixed chart collection. -/
52 noncomputable def fan (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
53     JunctionFan T (chain.vertex i.succ.castSucc) :=
54   charts.fan _ (charts.internal_nonvertex (chain.edge i.castSucc).symm
55     (chain.edge i.succ) (chain.internal_neighbors_different i))
56 
57 /-- The source angle charged for this actual edge, in the fixed chart collection. -/
58 noncomputable def sourceAngle (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (i : Fin (n + 2)) : ℝ :=
59   (charts.triangles (chain.edge i)).model.sourceAngle
60 
61 theorem sourceAngle_pos (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
62     0 < chain.sourceAngle charts i := (charts.triangles (chain.edge i)).model.sourceAngle_pos
63 
64 /-- The accumulated source angle before the edge with numerical index `k`. -/
65 noncomputable def angleBefore (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
66   ∑ i : Fin (n + 2) with i.val < k, chain.sourceAngle charts i
67 
68 theorem angleBefore_zero (charts : CutTreeCharts T) : chain.angleBefore charts 0 = 0 := by
69   simp [angleBefore]
70 
71 theorem angleBefore_nonneg (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ chain.angleBefore charts k :=
72   Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (chain.sourceAngle_pos charts i).le)
73 
74 theorem angleBefore_le_total (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (k : ℕ) :
75     chain.angleBefore charts k ≤ ∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i :=
76   Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
77     (fun i _ _ => (chain.sourceAngle_pos charts i).le)
78 
79 /-- Extending the prefix charges precisely the next actual kite angle. -/
80 theorem angleBefore_succ (charts : CutTreeCharts T) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
81     chain.angleBefore charts (i.val + 1) = chain.angleBefore charts i.val + chain.sourceAngle charts i := by
82   classical
83   have next : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (n + 2) => j.val < i.val + 1)) =
84       insert i (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (n + 2) => j.val < i.val)) := by
85     ext j
86     simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert]
87     constructor
88     · intro small
89       by_cases same : j.val = i.val
90       · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext same)
91       · exact Or.inr (by omega)
92     · rintro (rfl | smaller) <;> omega
93   have absent : i ∉ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (n + 2) => j.val < i.val) := by simp
94   simp only [angleBefore]
95   rw [next, Finset.sum_insert absent]
96   ring
97 
98 end CutTreeChain
99 
100 namespace SixVertexGraph
101 
102 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
103   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
104     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
105 
106 include small_faces in
107 /-- The actual source cone bounds the sum along every simple finite chain. -/
108 theorem cut_tree_chain_source_budget {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
109     (charts : CutTreeCharts T) {n : ℕ} (chain : CutTreeChain T n)
110     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space)) :
111     (∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i) < π := by
112   classical
113   letI : Fintype T.vertices := T.finite_vertices.fintype
114   letI : DecidableRel T.graph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
115   let models (d : T.graph.Dart) := (charts.triangles d.adj).model
116   let selected := Finset.univ.image chain.dart
117   have no_reverse : ∀ d ∈ selected, d.symm ∉ selected := by
118     rintro d member reverse
119     obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp member
120     obtain ⟨j, _, same⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp reverse
121     exact chain.dart_ne_reverse i j same.symm
122   have bound := (T.selected_source_angle_sum_le_half models selected no_reverse).trans_lt
123     (graph.half_source_angle_sum_lt_pi small_faces T models source at_source)
124   have sum_eq : (∑ d ∈ selected, (models d).sourceAngle) = ∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i := by
125     rw [Finset.sum_image]
126     · rfl
127     · exact fun _ _ _ _ same => chain.dart_injective same
128   rwa [sum_eq] at bound
129 
130 end SixVertexGraph
131 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
